component.name: GLeaks
component.summary: Know where your data has leaked

description.p: GLeaks helps you discover, understand and manage personal data exposures from your GNOME desktop. Your identifiers and results stay in one encrypted file that belongs to you, with no account and no cloud service.

ul.li: Encrypted, portable profiles you can move between computers
See which sites have a public page with your nickname, with no API key
Search the web for exact mentions of your identifiers
Optionally check email addresses against Have I Been Pwned with your own API key
Follow each search step by step in a live log
You see exactly what will be sent before anything leaves your computer
A private search mode that never sends the full address, on supported plans
A lasting history of what each source reported, and when
Follow up with suggested actions, without alarmist scores

description.p: First release: encrypted profiles, Have I Been Pwned checks, history and actions.
